title: Diagnose non-deterministic binary builds caused by embedded timestamps
input: Two consecutive builds of a C application produced differing SHA-256 hashes. Running diffoscope shows discrepancies inside the `.rodata` section containing current date and time strings. How should this be resolved to ensure deterministic compilation?
evidence_requirements: Identification of __DATE__ and __TIME__ compiler macros or wall-clock usage
Exporting SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH tied to the last git commit or changelog entry
Replacing volatile compile-time macros with static version strings or SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH-aware tooling

title: Analyze diffoscope output for archive ordering and file permission variance
input: A package build archive differs between builder nodes. The diffoscope report shows: `file list order differs in data.tar.xz` and `permissions 0644 vs 0664`. What caused these variances and what build flags eliminate them?
evidence_requirements: Identification of filesystem readdir ordering non-determinism and umask variances across build hosts
Using tar --sort=name to enforce deterministic directory traversal order
Using tar --mode=go=rX,u+rw or explicit umask 0022 normalization to clamp permissions

title: Eliminate host-specific build paths from debug symbols and binaries
input: A software package builds with different hashes when compiled in `/home/alice/src` vs `/builds/runner-2/src`. Diffoscope shows path differences in the `.debug_info` DWARF sections. How can absolute build paths be normalized across builds?
evidence_requirements: Identification of compiler embedding absolute working directory paths into debug symbols

title: Generate and validate standardized SPDX 2.3 JSON Software Bill of Materials
input: An enterprise client requires a machine-readable Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) for a deployed Linux service. What data must the SBOM contain to satisfy modern compliance standards and what tooling can generate and validate it?
evidence_requirements: Generation of SPDX 2.3/3.0 or CycloneDX 1.5 JSON manifest
Inclusion of component names, versions, Package URLs (purl), licenses, and cryptographic hashes (SHA-256)
Validation of SBOM schema using tools such as syft and spdx-tools

title: Generate and verify SLSA Level 3 build provenance attestation
input: To achieve SLSA Build Level 3 compliance, a build pipeline must generate an authenticated, non-forgeable record of how the package was produced. What information must be recorded in the in-toto provenance predicate and how is it verified?
evidence_requirements: Creation of in-toto provenance statement binding artifact digest to build parameters
Recording of immutable source repository URI, git commit SHA, build type, and builder ID
Verification using slsa-verifier or Sigstore Cosign against public transparency log

title: Harden build scripts against host environment contamination and randomness
input: A build script produces different binaries depending on whether it is run by a user in Germany, the US, or on a build server with 64 vs 4 CPU cores. What environment sanitization must be enforced?
evidence_requirements: Enforcing locale normalization: export LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 and LANG=C.UTF-8
Disabling multi-threaded non-deterministic compiler output or seeding compiler PRNGs (-frandom-seed)
